preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string S is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: S contains only lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: The string S consists of lowercase English letters only.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 1000000
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings S across all test cases does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' if it's impossible to make the string S a palindrome, or 'YES' if it's possible.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'YES', then output contains a single integer representing the minimum number of operations required to make the string S a palindrome
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then it must also include an integer representing the minimum number of operations needed to convert the string S into a palindrome.
